items.title: Tide Detergent
items.descID: Tide — brand detergen asal Amerika. MB Agency mengembangkan desain social media campaign berbentuk Instagram carousel untuk memperkuat pesan “cold water clean”, dengan fokus pada edukasi manfaat mencuci menggunakan air dingin, pengangkatan noda harian, dan rutinitas laundry yang lebih praktis. Campaign ini dirancang dengan visual bold, clean, dan high-trust menggunakan identitas warna khas Tide.
items.descEN: Tide — American laundry detergent brand. MB Agency developed an Instagram carousel social media campaign to strengthen the “cold water clean” message, focusing on the benefits of washing with cold water, everyday stain removal, and a simpler laundry routine. The campaign was designed with a bold, clean, and high-trust visual direction inspired by Tide’s iconic brand colors.

items.title: Reese Chocolate - Brand Campaign Assets

items.descEN: A bold and crave-worthy Social Campaign for Reese’s, featuring custom image assets, social media carousel visuals, and hero imagery inspired by the brand’s iconic chocolate-and-peanut-butter character.

items.title: Reese Chocolate - Social Media Content
items.descID: Carousel visual Instagram untuk Reese’s Chocolate dengan konsep dessert hacks yang playful dan save-worthy. MB Agency menciptakan visual asset system berbasis AI + Human Direction yang premium, engaging, dan scroll-stopping.
items.descEN: Instagram carousel visuals for Reese’s Chocolate with a playful, save-worthy dessert hacks concept. MB Agency crafted a premium AI + Human Direction visual asset system designed to engage and stop the scroll.

items.title: TheRover - Social Media Campaign
items.descID: MB Agency berkolaborasi dengan The Rover untuk menciptakan konten visual berkualitas tinggi yang tidak hanya menampilkan keindahan properti, tetapi juga membangun kepercayaan yang lebih kuat, meningkatkan perceived value, dan mendukung kehadiran brand yang lebih profesional di pasar.
items.descEN: MB Agency partnered with The Rover to create high-quality visual content that not only showcases the beauty of the property, but also builds stronger trust, elevates perceived value, and supports a more professional market presence.

items.descID: BYD Kota — Menerjemahkan brief client menjadi satu sistem visual yang siap melaju. Campaign BYD M6 DM meliputi aset sosial media, carousel 5 slide, poster promosi, dan ad banner Meta/Google.
items.descEN: BYD Kota — Translating client brief into a high-performance visual system. BYD M6 DM campaign featuring social media assets, 5-slide carousel, promo posters, and Meta/Google ad banners.

items.title: The Rover Kerobokan — Landing Page
items.descID: The Rover Kerobokan (therover.web.id 🔗) — Website Landing Page interaktif untuk 24 exclusive Mezzanine dan Studio apartment suites di Bali. Dilengkapi sistem reservasi via WhatsApp, filter kamar, galeri foto, & lokasi Google Maps.
items.descEN: The Rover Kerobokan (therover.web.id 🔗) — Interactive Landing Page website for 24 exclusive Mezzanine and Studio apartment suites in Bali. Built with direct WhatsApp booking, room filter, photo gallery, and Google Maps integration.
